title: Read the traceback
story: `top_designs.py` crashes on scores.csv. Run it, read the traceback, and report the line number where it failed. (Hint for later: compare what the script looks for with the header of scores.csv.)

files.~/{{project}}/top_designs.py:
"""Print the five best designs by confidence."""
import csv
import sys

with open(sys.argv[1]) as handle:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))

rows.sort(key=lambda r: float(r["pLDDT"]), reverse=True)
for r in rows[:5]:
    print(r["name"], r["pLDDT"])

tasks.text: Type the line number where it failed

hints: Read a traceback from the bottom up: the last line is the error, and the line above names the file and line number.
